title: Paper on gig drivers’ knowledge practices published in the CSCW Journal
summary: Making the Gig Economy Infrastructure Work: Gig Drivers’ Adaptive, Algorithmic, and Social Knowledge Practices, by Rie Helene (Lindy) Hernandez, Qiurong Song, Yubo Kou, and Xinning Gui, was published in Computer Supported Cooperative Work (CSCW).
